text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `model_quant_enable` for gpt-lite in eu-west-1 to enable the 4-bit quant profile. Target window: tomorrow 09:45 UTC. Who can own the flip + smoke checks? Plan: gradual canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~15m if metrics look good.

ben: I can take the flip. Prefer 09:45 (there's a data-pipeline deploy at 09:30). 09:45 gives a bit of separation.

maria: 09:45 works for us. Canary hold points: 10% for 5m, 50% for 10m, then full if errors <0.5% and p95 latency delta < 50ms vs baseline.

alice: Smoke checklist I'll run: model 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency, tokenization errors in traces, and cost-per-token. Quick checks below.

alice: ```
# health check for model
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.prod/v1/health?model=gpt-lite&region=eu-west-1" | jq .status

# feature flag status
redwoodctl flags get model_quant_enable --env=prod --region=eu-west-1

# basic load test for canary (short run)
hey -n 200 -c 10 "https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate?model=gpt-lite" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

carol: Rollback steps (quick): flip `model_quant_enable=false` via `redwoodctl` (immediate), revert kernel-selection tag, and scale inference pool to previous size if we see degraded tail latency. Also open a rollback PR/incident channel if we flip back.

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch 09:40-10:20 UTC. Alert rules to observe: 5xx rate, queue depth, and node OOMs. If 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3 minutes or p95 delta > 50ms for 5 minutes, call for rollback. I will post in #incidents if thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: ✅ Scheduled flip: `model_quant_enable` at 09:45 UTC (eu-west-1). Runbook RB-31415 attached: https://runbooks.internal/rb-31415. Canary automation set to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual approval between phases.

ben: I'll run pre-checks at 09:30 and post a "ready to flip" update 5m before. I'll also paste the flip marker timestamps once done.

maria: Owner=ben, window=09:45 UTC, canary plan 10/50/100, rollback triggers = 5xx >0.5% for 3m or p95 +50ms for 5m. @sre-oncall please watch and @carol standby for rollback ops.

alice: :thumbsup: good plan, leaving monitoring dashboards up and will help triage traces if anything pops.

ben: Noted — will post status updates in this thread during the rollout.
